import sys

MOD = 998244353

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    l = int(data[2])
    r = int(data[3])
    cnt = r - l + 1
    cells = n * m
    if (n % 2 == 1) and (m % 2 == 1):
        answer = pow(cnt, cells, MOD)
    else:
        p = pow(cnt, cells - 1, MOD)
        inv2 = pow(2, MOD - 2, MOD)
        if cnt % 2 == 0:
            answer = p * (cnt // 2) % MOD
        else:
            add = p * ((cnt + 1) // 2) % MOD
            sub = (p - 1) % MOD * inv2 % MOD
            answer = (add - sub) % MOD
    print(answer)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
